Whether you're outfitting a scout troop with embroidered patches or handing out durable vinyl stickers at a campground expo, these items withstand sun and moisture. Choose from round buttons for giveaways, full-color stickers for water bottles, or woven patches for uniforms. They’re lightweight, affordable in bulk, and easy to customize with your logo or message.
